disclosure: All dialogue is fictional game-world parody and is not an authentic statement.

dialogue.required_hint: Choose whether to talk to Saria.

lines: You want to call Saria, I think.
She knows the forest quite well.
Talk to Saria, or say no.

dialogue.required_hint: Choose whether to talk to Navi instead.

lines: No Saria. That's your decision.
Maybe you want my advice instead.
Say yes or no; it's up to you.

dialogue.context: Navi offers to call Saria after giving advice
dialogue.required_hint: Choose whether to talk to Saria next.

lines: Maybe Saria gets the next word.
Very nice; she knows the forest.
Talk to her? Choose yes or no.

dialogue.required_hint: Choose whether to talk to Saria again.

lines: We can call Saria again.
Sometimes the second call is useful.
Choose yes if you want her.

dialogue.required_hint: This door cannot currently be opened.

lines: Strange. This door will not open.
A door ought to do one thing.
We need another approach.

dialogue.required_hint: Iron bars block the door and cannot be opened by hand.

lines: Those bars are serious iron.
You can pull all day; no result.
Your hands cannot open them.

dialogue.required_hint: A regular key is required to open the chained door.

lines: The chains tell you the answer.
I've dealt with many locked doors.
This one needs a Small Key.

dialogue.required_hint: A special Boss Key is required to open the door.

lines: This is not an ordinary lock.
A Small Key won't impress it.
Come back with the Boss Key.

dialogue.required_hint: Solve the current room's puzzle to uncover the entrance.

lines: Something covers the entrance.
The room is making us earn it.
Solve this puzzle to open the way.

dialogue.required_hint: The current key is not correct for this door.

lines: That key does not fit this lock.
Good key, perhaps. Wrong door.
Find the one made for this door.

dialogue.required_hint: Inspect the nearby point of interest.

lines: Now, what is that over there?
People miss these things. I don't.
Take a look before we move on.

dialogue.required_hint: Use the first-person view to look below the web.

lines: There's a whole room below us.
The web hides it, but not well.
Look down with the C-Up view.

dialogue.required_hint: Climb the rough wall using its vines.

lines: Look at that wall--rough, vines.
I've seen climbable walls before.
This is one. Go straight up.

dialogue.required_hint: Stand at a door and press A when the Action Icon appears.

lines: Doors are simple, generally.
Stand close and watch the blue icon.
When it says Open, press A.

dialogue.required_hint: Notice the old ladder hanging overhead.

lines: They left a ladder hanging there.
Old ladder, but it may be useful.
Find a way to bring it down.

dialogue.required_hint: Notice that the design matches the Door of Time.

lines: I've seen that design before.
Same mark as the Door of Time.
That cannot be an accident.

dialogue.required_hint: The torch was burning recently and may be relit.

lines: This torch was burning recently.
You can tell. The evidence is there.
See if we can light it again.

dialogue.required_hint: Use Z targeting to look and sidestep around blind corners.

lines: Narrow halls invite an ambush.
They wait around corners--typical.
Hold Z and sidestep to look first.

dialogue.required_hint: Use A and the Control Stick to push, pull, or climb the block.

lines: This block can work for us.
Grab it with A; push or pull it.
Press toward it with A to climb.

dialogue.required_hint: Hold A in the water to dive and search below.

lines: There's more under the water.
There usually is; nobody checks.
Get in, hold A, and dive down.

dialogue.required_hint: Find a way to ignite all the Bomb Flowers at once.

lines: That's a field of Bomb Flowers.
One explosion could start the rest.
Set them all off together.

dialogue.required_hint: Avoid the many lava pits in this room.

lines: A lot of lava in this room.
No railings, no plan, no surprise.
Watch every step you take.

dialogue.required_hint: Activate the switch and quickly ride the platform to the second floor.

lines: That switch raises the platform.
It will not wait around for us.
Hit it and ride to floor two.

dialogue.required_hint: Use Z targeting to look safely around narrow corners.

lines: Another blind corner. I know them.
Something always waits back there.
Use Z and look before turning.

dialogue.context: Look at a point of interest
dialogue.required_hint: Inspect the object or area Navi is indicating.

lines: What exactly are we looking at?
It caught your eye for a reason.
Check it closely before leaving.

dialogue.required_hint: Inspect the ominous face of the Desert Colossus.

lines: That face is not welcoming us.
I've seen friendlier desert statues.
Inspect the Colossus carefully.

dialogue.required_hint: Use the Lens of Truth to reveal the room's secret.

lines: The spirits are giving a clue.
They whisper; I prefer plain talk.
Use the eye of truth here.

dialogue.required_hint: Use the Hover Boots and let the wind guide you to the hidden path.

lines: The spirits mention sacred feet.
A dramatic way to say the boots.
Wear Hover Boots; follow the wind.

dialogue.required_hint: Watch for danger attacking from above.

lines: The wall says danger is above.
Useful warning, surprisingly clear.
Keep watching the ceiling.

dialogue.required_hint: Watch for danger beneath the floor or platform.

lines: Now the wall says danger below.
This room covers every direction.
Watch the ground under you.

dialogue.required_hint: Stop or redirect the water flowing from the statue.

lines: That statue floods the whole floor.
An astonishing plumbing decision.
Stop that flow to change the room.

dialogue.required_hint: Avoid touching the electrified green tentacle.

lines: The green slime is electrified.
Touching it would be a bad deal.
Keep away while it has power.

dialogue.required_hint: Avoid touching the electrified red tentacle.

lines: That red slime carries current.
It looks soft; it is not friendly.
Do not touch it while charged.

dialogue.required_hint: Avoid touching the electrified blue tentacle.

lines: The blue slime has power too.
Different color, same awful shock.
Stay clear until it is safe.

dialogue.required_hint: Place something heavy on the switch because Link alone is too light.

lines: This switch wants more weight.
You alone do not close the deal.
Put something heavy on it.

dialogue.required_hint: Cut the matching tail to remove each colored tentacle.

lines: Cutting that tail removed the red.
So the tails control these things.
Cut the matching ones as well.

dialogue.required_hint: Find a way to activate the switch hidden beyond the wall.

lines: There's a switch behind this wall.
They hid it, but we found it.
Reach it or strike it from here.

dialogue.required_hint: Inspect or reach the object on top of the platform.

lines: Something is up on that platform.
High place, deliberate placement.
Get up there and inspect it.

dialogue.required_hint: Determine which flags are real and which are illusions.

lines: Look at all these flags.
Most are fake--you can feel it.
Find which ones are actually real.

dialogue.required_hint: Collect all five Silver Rupees in the room.

lines: A voice says five Silver Rupees.
Specific number, simple assignment.
Collect all five to proceed.

dialogue.required_hint: Come to this point to reveal or board the ferry to the other world.

lines: The wall offers a ferry ride.
To the other world--quite a route.
Come here when you want the boat.

dialogue.required_hint: Ride the old boat carefully because it may sink.

lines: That boat is extremely old.
Would I certify it? I would not.
Ride carefully; it may sink.

dialogue.required_hint: Find a way across the gap to reach the door.

lines: There's our door across the gap.
Close enough to see, not to reach.
Find a way over to it.

dialogue.required_hint: Find a special method or substance that can melt the red ice.

lines: That red ice is unusual.
Normal fire may not make the deal.
Find something special to melt it.

dialogue.required_hint: Capture or use Blue Fire to melt unusual ice.

lines: Blue Fire is not natural fire.
That usually means it has a use.
Capture some and try it on ice.

dialogue.required_hint: Defeat the Poe ghosts to restore the missing torch flames.

lines: The torch flames are all gone.
The ghosts took them--very obvious.
Defeat each ghost; bring them back.

dialogue.required_hint: Defeating a Poe restores one of the torch flames.

lines: One torch is burning again.
You beat a ghost; the flame returns.
So that is how this room works.

dialogue.required_hint: Follow or interpret the arrows painted on the floor.

lines: They painted arrows on the floor.
Not subtle, but perhaps helpful.
See where they are pointing.

dialogue.required_hint: Observe how the corridor's orientation has changed.

lines: This entire corridor is twisted.
Walls, floor--a total rearrangement.
Adjust to its new direction.

dialogue.required_hint: Watch the ground for shadows cast by monsters above.

lines: The ceiling monsters cast shadows.
They think nobody looks down.
Watch the floor and dodge them.

dialogue.required_hint: Open the nearby treasure chest.

lines: There's a treasure chest here.
Could be useful; could be nonsense.
Open it and we will know.

dialogue.required_hint: Recognize this as the torch from the temple entrance.

lines: We saw this torch at the entrance.
Same torch, moved or connected.
Remember it for this puzzle.

dialogue.required_hint: A lit torch signals progress in the Poe puzzle.

lines: That torch is lit now.
Something we did caused it.
It marks progress in this room.

dialogue.required_hint: Melt the ice that is preventing the switch from moving.

lines: The switch is frozen solid.
A switch that cannot switch--bad.
Melt the ice around it.

dialogue.required_hint: Move through the room while avoiding the falling ceiling.

lines: The ceiling is coming down.
No warning, no standards at all.
Move now and avoid the crush.

dialogue.required_hint: Search below for the imprisoned Gorons.

lines: I hear Gorons below us.
They're probably trapped down there.
Find a route to reach them.

dialogue.required_hint: Recognize and reach the room below where Darunia appeared.

lines: Look down--Darunia's room.
We have seen it from below before.
Now find a way back into it.

dialogue.required_hint: Recall the similar statue seen earlier and use that clue.

lines: That statue looks familiar.
We saw one before; same design.
Use what worked the first time.

dialogue.required_hint: Use a strong impact, such as the Megaton Hammer, on the rusted switch.

lines: That switch is badly rusted.
A gentle touch will do nothing.
Hit it with something heavy.

dialogue.required_hint: Avoid being pulled into the water vortexes.

lines: These vortexes pull very hard.
They swallow anything nearby.
Keep your distance and swim clear.

dialogue.required_hint: Answer the Great Deku Tree's summons.

lines: The Great Deku Tree summoned us.
A tree that important doesn't call
without a reason. Let's go.

dialogue.required_hint: Enter the Great Deku Tree.

lines: We came all this way to the tree.
Some people stop at the entrance.
We're going inside. Be brave.

dialogue.required_hint: Travel to Hyrule Castle and visit Princess Zelda.

lines: The Deku Tree gave us a mission.
Visit the princess at the castle.
We should get moving.

dialogue.required_hint: Find Malon's missing father near Hyrule Castle.

lines: The ranch girl lost her father.
How do you lose a full-grown man?
Find him near the castle.

dialogue.required_hint: Search Hyrule Castle for Princess Zelda.

lines: This castle is bigger than it looks.
Zelda is somewhere inside it.
Avoid the guards and find her.

dialogue.required_hint: Ask Saria what she knows about saving Hyrule.

lines: Saria knows the forest network.
She hears things before others do.
Ask what she knows about Hyrule.

dialogue.required_hint: Search Death Mountain for the Spiritual Stone of Fire.

lines: Impa gave us a solid lead.
The Fire Stone is on the mountain.
Search Death Mountain for it.

dialogue.required_hint: Use a Bomb Flower to enter Dodongo's Cavern.

lines: The cavern entrance is blocked.
Fortunately, bombs change a deal.
Use a Bomb Flower to get in.

dialogue.required_hint: Visit the Great Fairy at the top of Death Mountain.

lines: Darunia mentioned a Great Fairy.
Lives at the summit, apparently.
Climb Death Mountain and visit.

dialogue.context: Ask Saria about the Water Stone
dialogue.required_hint: Ask Saria about the remaining Spiritual Stone.

lines: One Spiritual Stone remains.
Saria may know who controls it.
Call her and ask about the stone.

dialogue.required_hint: Enter Jabu-Jabu and find Princess Ruto.

lines: Ruto is inside a giant fish.
That is the report, unbelievably.
Enter Jabu-Jabu and find her.

dialogue.required_hint: Return to Hyrule Castle with the three Spiritual Stones.

lines: We have all three stones now.
That took work; nobody handed them
to us. Return to Hyrule Castle.

dialogue.required_hint: Search the castle moat for what Zelda threw from the white horse.

lines: Zelda threw something in the moat.
I watched it happen--very clear.
Search the water and recover it.

dialogue.required_hint: Enter and investigate the Temple of Time.

lines: We have the stones and ocarina.
That combination means something.
Check inside the Temple of Time.

dialogue.required_hint: Go to Kakariko Village as Sheik instructed.

lines: Sheik says go to Kakariko.
Mysterious person, but good record.
Let's follow the lead for now.

dialogue.required_hint: Return to the forest and investigate what happened to Saria.

lines: Something changed in the forest.
And Saria has gone quiet too.
Go back and investigate both.

dialogue.required_hint: Investigate the strange cloud over Death Mountain.

lines: That cloud over Death Mountain--
it does not look like weather.
Go up there and investigate.

dialogue.required_hint: Follow the freezing wind toward Zora's Domain.

lines: Cold wind comes from Zora's River.
This is not normal Hyrule weather.
Follow it toward the Domain.

dialogue.required_hint: Use the Iron Boots to walk at the bottom of Lake Hylia.

lines: Those Iron Boots weigh a ton.
Usually a problem; here, an asset.
Wear them at the bottom of the lake.

dialogue.required_hint: Find someone who knows about the other Sages.

lines: We still need the other Sages.
Somebody in Hyrule knows where.
Find a person with information.

dialogue.required_hint: Investigate the well in Kakariko Village.

lines: That monster came from the well.
People ignored it until it escaped.
Go back and inspect the well.

dialogue.required_hint: Investigate the Spirit Temple and who built it.

lines: Who built the Spirit Temple?
Nobody builds that in the desert
without a purpose. Investigate.

dialogue.required_hint: Play the Nocturne of Shadow that Sheik taught you.

lines: Sheik taught us the Nocturne.
Songs tend to open unusual routes.
Play the Nocturne of Shadow.

dialogue.required_hint: Travel to the desert and search for the next lead.

lines: Ganondorf came from the desert.
That makes it worth examining.
Go there and search for a lead.

dialogue.required_hint: Equip the Silver Gauntlets and move previously immovable objects.

lines: Now we have Silver Gauntlets.
Things that would not move before
are negotiable. Equip them.

dialogue.required_hint: Meet the person waiting at the Temple of Time.

lines: Someone waits at the Temple of Time.
I have a strong idea who it is.
Go there and meet them.

dialogue.required_hint: Enter Ganon's Castle and rescue Princess Zelda.

lines: Zelda is held in Ganon's Castle.
He made it grand; still a prison.
Get inside and rescue her.

dialogue.required_hint: Keep moving and continue the current objective.

lines: We're still moving forward.
There may be no fresh lead yet.
Keep going with the current job.

enemies.name: Unknown target
enemies.required_hint: Observe the target and use the appropriate weapon.
lines: We don't know this one yet.
Watch how it moves; choose a weapon.

enemies.name: Gohma
enemies.required_hint: Stun Gohma's eye when it turns red, then attack.
lines: Gohma has one eye doing everything.
When it turns red, stun and strike.

enemies.name: Gohma Egg
enemies.required_hint: Destroy the egg before it hatches.
lines: That egg becomes a bigger problem.
Break it now, before it hatches.

enemies.name: Gohma Larva
enemies.required_hint: Defend against its leap and counterattack.
lines: The larva commits to every jump.
Block the leap, then counter.

enemies.name: Skulltula
enemies.required_hint: Attack the soft belly when the Skulltula turns around.
lines: Armor in front, soft underneath.
Wait for it to turn; hit the belly.

enemies.name: Big Skulltula
enemies.required_hint: Wait for the Big Skulltula to expose its belly, then attack.
lines: The bigger one has the same flaw.
Wait for the belly, then strike.

enemies.name: Tailpasaran
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its electric body and attack the tail.
lines: The body is one electric trap.
Avoid it and attack the tail.

enemies.name: Deku Baba
enemies.required_hint: Attack after it lunges or stun it with a Deku Nut.
lines: Deku Baba. All mouth, no results.
Dodge the lunge, then attack.

enemies.name: Big Deku Baba
enemies.required_hint: Cut the stem after avoiding its bite.
lines: Big Deku Baba. Overgrown menace.
Avoid the bite. Cut the stem.

enemies.name: Withered Deku Baba
enemies.required_hint: Attack it to obtain a Deku Stick.
lines: Withered Baba. Barely functioning.
Cut it down for a Deku Stick.

enemies.name: Deku Scrub
enemies.required_hint: Reflect its Deku Nut with the shield.
lines: Deku Scrub. Throws nuts and hides.
Reflect one with your shield.

enemies.name: King Dodongo
enemies.required_hint: Throw a bomb into its open mouth, then attack when it falls.
lines: He opens his mouth before rolling.
Feed him a bomb, then strike.

enemies.name: Dodongo
enemies.required_hint: Attack its tail and avoid the explosion after defeat.
lines: The armor stops before the tail.
Hit there, then avoid the blast.

enemies.name: Baby Dodongo
enemies.required_hint: Avoid it until it explodes and use the blast strategically.
lines: Baby Dodongo. Tiny demolition crew.
Back away when it starts flashing.

enemies.name: Lizalfos
enemies.required_hint: Guard its attacks and counter when it lands.
lines: Lizalfos. Lots of jumping around.
Guard, then counter when it lands.

enemies.name: Dinolfos
enemies.required_hint: Block its strong attacks and counter carefully.
lines: Dinolfos. Tougher, still beatable.
Block the attack, then punish it.

enemies.name: Fire Keese
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its fire and use a ranged attack.
lines: A burning Keese wants to get close.
Shoot it before it reaches you.

enemies.name: Keese
enemies.required_hint: Use a ranged weapon or strike when it approaches.
lines: A Keese circles until it can dive.
Shoot it, or strike as it comes in.

enemies.name: Armos
enemies.required_hint: Wake it, attack its back, and avoid its final explosion.
lines: The statue moves once disturbed.
Hit its back, then clear the blast.

enemies.name: Barinade
enemies.required_hint: Use the boomerang to sever supports and stun the core.
lines: Barinade. An electrical mess.
Boomerang the links and the core.

enemies.name: Parasitic Tentacle
enemies.required_hint: Use the boomerang to cut the narrow section.
lines: Tentacle. Disgusting obstruction.
Boomerang the narrow section.

enemies.name: Shabom
enemies.required_hint: Pop it with a projectile or shielded contact.
lines: Shabom. A bubble playing warrior.
Pop it with a projectile.

enemies.name: Biri
enemies.required_hint: Stun or attack it without touching its electricity.
lines: Biri carries electricity outside.
Stun it before you strike.

enemies.name: Bari
enemies.required_hint: Stun it, split it, then defeat the smaller Biri.
lines: The large jelly splits when hit.
Stun it, split it, clear the pieces.

enemies.name: Stinger
enemies.required_hint: Force it from hiding and attack with ranged weapons.
lines: Stinger. Hiding under the floor.
Draw it out, then shoot it.

enemies.name: Phantom Ganon, mounted
enemies.required_hint: Identify the real rider and shoot him as he exits a painting.
lines: Most riders in the frames are fake.
Shoot the real one as he exits.

enemies.name: Stalfos
enemies.required_hint: Block its sword and counter during an opening.
lines: A Stalfos trusts its sword too much.
Block the swing, then counter.

enemies.name: Blue Bubble
enemies.required_hint: Remove its blue flame, then attack the skull.
lines: Blue Bubble. Inflated reputation.
Remove the flame, hit the skull.

enemies.name: White Bubble
enemies.required_hint: Wait for it to stop, then attack the skull.
lines: White Bubble. It spins, it stops.
Wait for the stop, then strike.

enemies.name: Green Bubble
enemies.required_hint: Wait for its flame to vanish, then attack.
lines: Its green flame always drops away.
Wait it out, then attack the skull.

enemies.name: Skullwalltula
enemies.required_hint: Shoot it before climbing within attack range.
lines: It controls the wall above us.
Shoot it before you climb past.

enemies.name: Gold Skulltula
enemies.required_hint: Defeat it and collect the token with a ranged tool if needed.
lines: This Skulltula leaves proof behind.
Defeat it and collect the token.

enemies.name: Volvagia
enemies.required_hint: Use the Megaton Hammer when Volvagia emerges, then attack its head.
lines: Volvagia. A tunneling dragon.
Hammer the head when it emerges.

enemies.name: Flare Dancer
enemies.required_hint: Use the Hookshot to pull out its core, then attack it.
lines: All that fire protects a small core.
Hookshot it out, then attack.

enemies.name: Torch Slug
enemies.required_hint: Extinguish its flame, then attack quickly.
lines: The slug is dangerous while burning.
Put out the flame, then strike.

enemies.name: Red Bubble
enemies.required_hint: Use the shield or wait for its flame to drop, then attack.
lines: Red Bubble. Hot air with a skull.
Block it, then hit the bare skull.

enemies.name: Morpha
enemies.required_hint: Hookshot the nucleus out of the water and attack it.
lines: The water only protects the core.
Hookshot it out, then strike.

enemies.name: Dark Link
enemies.required_hint: Vary attacks and avoid predictable sword strikes.
lines: He copies the attacks he expects.
Change your timing; surprise him.

enemies.name: Shell Blade
enemies.required_hint: Attack the exposed interior when the shell opens.
lines: Shell Blade. Weak in the center.
Strike only when it opens.

enemies.name: Spike
enemies.required_hint: Use the Hookshot or a projectile when its spikes retract.
lines: Spike. All defense, little talent.
Attack when the spikes retract.

enemies.name: Bongo Bongo
enemies.required_hint: Use the Lens of Truth, shoot both hands, then attack the eye.
lines: Invisible, but the Lens exposes him.
Shoot both hands, then the eye.

enemies.name: Redead
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its paralyzing gaze and attack from behind.
lines: A Redead wins when you face it.
Avoid the gaze; get behind it.

enemies.name: Phantom Ganon
enemies.required_hint: Reflect the energy ball, then attack when he is stunned.
lines: He expects his magic to scare us.
Reflect the orb, then rush him.

enemies.name: Gibdo
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its paralyzing gaze and attack from behind.
lines: Gibdo. Wrapped up, still a mess.
Avoid the gaze. Attack the back.

enemies.name: Dead Hand's hand
enemies.required_hint: Let a hand grab Link to draw out Dead Hand, then escape.
lines: The hand is bait, but also a clue.
Let it draw out the real target.

enemies.name: Dead Hand
enemies.required_hint: Bait it from underground, escape the hands, and attack its head.
lines: Dead Hand hides until one grabs you.
Escape, draw it out, hit the head.

enemies.name: Wallmaster
enemies.required_hint: Watch its shadow, dodge the falling hand, and attack it.
lines: The hand announces itself below.
Watch the shadow; dodge and strike.

enemies.name: Floormaster
enemies.required_hint: Defeat it and quickly destroy all three small hands.
lines: It divides when you think it's done.
Destroy all three pieces quickly.

enemies.name: Koume
enemies.required_hint: Reflect Kotake's ice attack into Koume with the Mirror Shield.
lines: Koume controls fire, not ice.
Reflect Kotake's ice into her.

enemies.name: Kotake
enemies.required_hint: Reflect Koume's fire attack into Kotake with the Mirror Shield.
lines: Kotake controls ice, not fire.
Reflect Koume's fire into her.

enemies.name: Nabooru Iron Knuckle
enemies.required_hint: Dodge the axe, counterattack, and break the armor.
lines: Iron Knuckle. Nabooru is inside.
Dodge the axe and break the armor.

enemies.name: Iron Knuckle
enemies.required_hint: Dodge the axe and counterattack during recovery.
lines: Heavy armor slows the axe recovery.
Dodge, then attack the opening.

enemies.name: Adult Skull Kid
enemies.required_hint: Use ranged attacks from a safe distance.
lines: This Skull Kid attacks from range.
Answer from a safe distance.

enemies.name: Like Like
enemies.required_hint: Keep distance and attack before it can swallow equipment.
lines: Like Like. It steals your equipment.
Keep away and strike quickly.

enemies.name: Beamos
enemies.required_hint: Destroy it with a bomb while avoiding its beam.
lines: Beamos. Surveillance gone wrong.
Avoid the beam and use a bomb.

enemies.name: Anubis
enemies.required_hint: Use fire or mirror its movement into a flame.
lines: Anubis copies every move you make.
Lead that copy into a flame.

enemies.name: Freezard
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its freezing breath and use fire or repeated attacks.
lines: Freezard. Cold, slow, unpleasant.
Avoid the breath. Fire works well.

enemies.name: Ganondorf
enemies.required_hint: Reflect his magic, use Light Arrows, then attack with the sword.
lines: He throws magic and expects fear.
Reflect it, use Light, then sword.

enemies.name: Ganon
enemies.required_hint: Use Light Arrows, attack the tail, and finish with the Master Sword.
lines: All that size, and the tail is open.
Use Light, hit tail, then the Sword.

enemies.name: Skull Kid
enemies.required_hint: Play music or use an appropriate ranged interaction.
lines: Skull Kid. Wants entertainment.
Try music before starting trouble.

enemies.name: Friendly Skull Kid
enemies.required_hint: Play Saria's Song to befriend the Skull Kid.
lines: This Skull Kid could be an ally.
Play Saria's Song. Make the deal.

enemies.name: Masked Skull Kid
enemies.required_hint: Interact with the Skull Kid while wearing the requested mask.
lines: Skull Kid likes that mask.
Talk business and make the trade.

enemies.name: Octorok
enemies.required_hint: Reflect its rock back with the shield.
lines: Octorok. Throws rocks, then hides.
Shield the rock right back at it.

enemies.name: Composer Poe
enemies.required_hint: Use the sword or ranged attacks and collect its soul after defeat.
lines: The composer performs as a Poe.
Attack it and capture the soul.

enemies.name: Poe
enemies.required_hint: Wait for it to become visible, then attack and collect its soul.
lines: Poe. Invisible when challenged.
Wait for it to appear, then strike.

enemies.name: Red Tektite
enemies.required_hint: Guard against its jumps and attack after it lands.
lines: Red Tektite. Constant jumping.
Block the landing, then attack.

enemies.name: Blue Tektite
enemies.required_hint: Lure it to stable ground and attack after its jump.
lines: It hops on water, but fights ashore.
Lure it there and counter.

enemies.name: Leever
enemies.required_hint: Keep moving and attack when it emerges from the sand.
lines: It hides until you stop watching.
Keep moving; strike when it rises.

enemies.name: Peahat
enemies.required_hint: Attack its vulnerable roots when it lands.
lines: The blades hide vulnerable roots.
Wait for it to land; hit the roots.

enemies.name: Peahat Larva
enemies.required_hint: Defend against its charge and counterattack.
lines: The larva flies straight at you.
Block the charge, then strike.

enemies.name: Moblin
enemies.required_hint: Avoid its charge and attack from behind or at range.
lines: Moblin. Big guard, narrow vision.
Dodge the charge. Hit the back.

enemies.name: Club Moblin
enemies.required_hint: Avoid the shockwaves and attack from behind.
lines: Club Moblin. Loud club, slow turn.
Avoid shockwaves. Get behind it.

enemies.name: Wolfos
enemies.required_hint: Guard, circle behind it, and attack its vulnerable back.
lines: Wolfos leaves its back unprotected.
Guard, circle, strike from behind.

enemies.name: Mad Scrub
enemies.required_hint: Reflect its Deku Nuts with the shield.
lines: Mad Scrub. Angry and inaccurate.
Reflect its nuts with your shield.

enemies.name: Business Scrub
enemies.required_hint: Reflect its projectile, then speak to it after surrender.
lines: Business Scrub. Tough negotiator.
Reflect one shot, then make a deal.

enemies.name: Dampe's Ghost
enemies.required_hint: Follow Dampe closely through the graveyard race.
lines: Dampe's ghost knows the route.
Follow closely. Do not fall behind.

enemies.name: Poe Sister Meg
enemies.required_hint: Use the bow to identify and shoot the real Meg among her copies.
lines: Meg surrounds herself with copies.
Find the real one and use the bow.

enemies.name: Poe Sister Joelle
enemies.required_hint: Attack when she becomes visible and complete the torch puzzle.
lines: Joelle guards one of four flames.
Strike when seen; light the torch.

enemies.name: Poe Sister Beth
enemies.required_hint: Attack when she becomes visible and complete the torch puzzle.
lines: Beth vanishes to avoid the fight.
Wait until seen; light the torch.

enemies.name: Poe Sister Amy
enemies.required_hint: Attack when she becomes visible and complete the block puzzle.
lines: Amy. Hiding behind a block puzzle.
Solve it, then strike when visible.

enemies.name: Gerudo Thief
enemies.required_hint: Block her attacks and counter when her guard opens.
lines: Gerudo guard. Tough, not unbeatable.
Block her strike, then counter.

enemies.name: Stalchild
enemies.required_hint: Use ordinary sword attacks and watch for larger variants at night.
lines: Stalchildren rise after dark.
A few sword strikes put one down.

enemies.name: Ice Keese
enemies.required_hint: Use a ranged attack before it can freeze Link.
lines: One touch from it can freeze you.
Shoot it before it reaches you.

enemies.name: White Wolfos
enemies.required_hint: Guard, circle behind it, and attack its vulnerable back.
lines: White Wolfos. Nice fur, same flaw.
Circle behind and strike the back.

enemies.name: Guay
enemies.required_hint: Use a ranged attack or strike when it dives.
lines: The Guay must dive to threaten us.
Shoot it or strike during the dive.

enemies.name: Bigocto
enemies.required_hint: Stun it with the boomerang and attack its exposed rear.
lines: Bigocto. Blocks the whole platform.
Boomerang it, then hit the rear.

enemies.name: Big Poe
enemies.required_hint: Defeat it quickly, then bottle its soul before it disappears.
lines: Big Poe. A valuable ghost asset.
Defeat it and bottle the soul fast.

enemies.name: Twinrova
enemies.required_hint: Absorb three attacks of one element with the Mirror Shield and release the charge.
lines: The witches alternate fire and ice.
Absorb three matching attacks.

enemies.name: Wasteland Poe
enemies.required_hint: Follow the Poe through the Haunted Wasteland without losing sight of it.
lines: Wasteland Poe knows the safe route.
Follow it closely through the sand.
